message:
You know that one friend who turns every little storm warning into a full-blown crisis? I once watched her pack for a winter storm like she was preparing for a month-long expedition. 

While I was just filling a couple of water bottles and checking the pantry for snacks, she was rummaging through her closet for snow boots, a parka, and—believe it or not—a snow shovel! 

In the end, we both ended up cozy with hot cocoa, but I learned that a little calm can go a long way. 

So, my tip? Keep it simple and stay relaxed. What’s your go-to trick for weathering the storm?
